rows.grounds: adjective qualifying the object of remembrance as ordinary or general
fused form of smaranti and enam; internal sandhi noted, analyzed as given
demonstrative pronoun referring to those who hold this view
verb expressing the resulting movement or fate
compound denoting the ocean of hell as destination

items.question: What consequence follows from regarding the Lord as common?
premises: Some people remember the Lord as common.
Such people proceed to a dire destination.
That destination is described as the ocean of hell.
items.inference: Regarding the Lord as common leads those people to the ocean of hell.
uncertainties: The referent of enam is inferred from the preceding context as the Lord.
items.plain_english: Those who remember him as common go to the ocean of hell.
